title: Story premise EDU119: The Siphon Drawing Has a Missing Condition
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (practical mechanisms). Hook: Is a bent tube enough to make this water move? Takeaway/theme: A mechanism diagram must state the conditions required for the depicted behavior.
description: An illustrator wants a tube animation to explain a siphon, but an attractive loop alone does not establish the necessary starting and height conditions. A reviewed cutaway labels the assumptions before any modeled flow is shown.
